module
public import HexPrimality.Elab
public meta import HexPrimality.Elab
public section
def certificate : Hex.Nat.PrimeCert := Hex.Nat.PrimeCert.pock 2147483647 [(3, 0, Hex.Nat.PrimeCert.small 151), (3, 0, Hex.Nat.PrimeCert.small 331)]
theorem result : Hex.Nat.Prime 2147483647 :=
  Hex.Nat.prime_of_checkPrimeAt (c := certificate) (by decide +kernel)

  e.replace fun sub => match sub with
